SELECT inventory.sku_id AS skuId, inventory.warehouse_id AS warehouseId, inventory.area_id AS areaId, SUM(inventory.quantity) AS quantity, item.item_name AS itemName, item.item_code AS itemCode, sku.sku_name AS skuName FROM wms_inventory inventory INNER JOIN wms_item_sku sku ON inventory.sku_id = sku.id INNER JOIN wms_item item ON sku.item_id = item.id
item.item_name LIKE concat('%', #{bo.itemName}, '%')
AND item.item_code LIKE concat('%', #{bo.itemCode}, '%')
AND sku.sku_name LIKE concat('%', #{bo.skuName}, '%')
AND inventory.warehouse_id = #{bo.warehouseId}
AND inventory.area_id = #{bo.areaId}
GROUP BY inventory.sku_id, inventory.warehouse_id, inventory.area_id, item.item_name, item.item_code, sku.sku_name ORDER BY inventory.warehouse_id, inventory.area_id, item.item_name, inventory.sku_id
